what: Dell sells PCs, servers, storage and networking gear. Servers built for AI have become its main growth driver.
customers: Businesses, public bodies, cloud providers and consumers.
money: AI and traditional servers, storage, networking
moat: A direct sales force with deep enterprise relationships, supply-chain scale and services bundled with hardware.

watch: AI server shipments and backlog, and storage margins.
